title: Tenant Route Negotiator: EU residency simulation harness and policy tuning
creator: Marta Nowak
description: Build a Tenant Route Negotiator simulation harness and a policy-tuning workflow to validate EU-only and tenant-scoped routing constraints. The goal is a developer-facing sandbox and automated test matrix that models: (1) region selection (EU vs non-EU), (2) tier routing (hosted vs dedicated vs private fallbacks), and (3) fallback model variants (full model vs quantized EU-compliant variant). The harness must exercise allowlist/denylist rules, emergency passthrough policies, and precedence resolution when multiple tenant or org-level policies conflict. Deliverables: (A) a standalone simulator service that can replay production-like traffic patterns with synthetic tenant headers and consent flags, (B) policy mutation tooling to create targeted test cases (e.g., tenant X forced to EU-only, tenant Y allowed cross-border), (C) a rule-debug view that shows evaluated decision graph and final route for every simulated request, and (D) a regression test suite that gates policy changes on metrics thresholds. This ticket focuses on the simulator and policy-tuning UX; integration with the routing decision service and the audit log sink will be separate follow-ups.
comments: 2026-01-16: Kickoff — scoped MVP simulator endpoints + basic policy DSL. Agreed to reuse routing-decision library for evaluation logic. (Marta)

2026-01-20: Prototype demo — simulator can replay 10k req/min single-tenant trace and surface route decisions. Observed ambiguous precedence when tenant-level denylist and org-level emergency passthrough both present. (Ravi)

2026-01-22: Design review — PM asked for explicit audit payloads per decision node; Security requested HSM-safe token sampling for test data. Action: add structured audit events and obfuscation option. (Design/PM/Security)

2026-01-28: Engineering sync — decided to implement soft-fence TTL (30s default) that allows temporary cross-border fallback under emergency passthrough with elevated logging. Need product acceptance. (Ravi)
2026-01-30: Blocker identified — current routing-decision library doesn't expose rule provenance. Added dependency ENG-99720 to add provenance metadata. (Marta)

2026-02-01: QA notes — regression suite includes 48 permutations across region/tier/consent/allowlist flags. Two failing cases: tier downgrade fallback incorrectly selected when dedicated pool is saturated. Investigating. (QA)
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can replay a 5-minute tenant trace and emit per-request decision with provenance for 100% of events
Policy mutation API allows creating tenant-scoped allowlist/denylist and toggling emergency passthrough with audit entries
Regression suite passes locally and on CI for the 48-case matrix with expected route outcomes
Soft-fence TTL behavior validated: temporary passthrough emits elevated audit events and is reversible
Performance: simulator end-to-end run for 5k req/min does not exceed 5x production routing latency for a single decision evaluation
rollout_plan: 1) Merge simulator prototype behind feature flag (runtime-2.3) and run internal playbook for 48-case matrix
2) Enable simulator for solutions and compliance teams in staging; collect debug traces for policy edge cases
3) Once ENG-99720 provenance work is merged, connect simulator to audit-log sink and re-run regression suite
4) Gradual rollout: open access to internal devs -> partner customers via opt-in -> default availability in sandbox environment
5) Post-rollout: run two-week policy chaos test to validate graceful fallback and no data egress violations
test_plan: Automated matrix: 48 permutations (region:EU/non-EU x tier:hosted/dedicated/private x consent:on/off x allowlist/denylist variants)
Synthetic load tests: 1k/5k/10k req/min traces, measure p95 decision latency and route stability
False-positive checks: ensure no cross-border route selected for tenants with EU-only flag in 100% of deterministic tests
Manual exploratory: security team will run sampled HSM-safe tokens through simulator to confirm obfuscation
Integration: connect to routing-decision service in staging and validate audit log completeness
metrics: incorrect-route-rate (percentage of simulated requests where selected route violates active rules)
soft-fallback-rate (percentage of requests that used emergency passthrough)
provenance-completeness (percentage of decisions with full provenance attached)
audit-ingest-latency (ms): time from decision -> audit sink
notes: Design trade-off: aggressive short-circuiting of allowlists speeds up decisions but can obscure why fallbacks occurred — will include full provenance in debug mode
Security: sampling for simulator must never include raw customer PII. Add SHA256-based tokenization as default for any production trace ingestion
PM priority: tie this to upcoming compliance audit in Q2; aim to have demonstrable policy proofs for enterprise customers
Follow-ups: separate tickets for integrating simulator results into console (per-tenant policy dashboard) and for automated rollback heuristics if soft-fallback rates exceed threshold
